instruction: Candid outdoor full shot of two women on a grassy lawn. On the left, the woman in the maroon patchwork dress (R2) stands barefoot, facing right and bowing slightly with her hands pressed together in a namaste gesture. On the right, the woman in the peach and blue dress (R1) bows forward deeply, facing left with her hands also in a namaste gesture. The two women face each other in a respectful greeting. The background features green bushes and trees under soft, natural daylight.
